```go
type Cache struct {
    data     map[string]*CacheEntry
    mu       sync.RWMutex  // RWMutex for read-heavy workloads
    ttl      time.Duration
    loader   LoadFunc
    stats    Stats
    conds    map[string]*sync.Cond  // For waiting on loads
}

// Use atomic operations for stats
import "sync/atomic"
atomic.AddInt64(&c.stats.Hits, 1)

// GetMulti needs WaitGroup
func (c *Cache) GetMulti(ctx context.Context, keys []string) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var mu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})
    
    for _, key := range keys {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            if value, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
                mu.Lock()
                results[k] = value
                mu.Unlock()
            }
        }(key)
    }
    wg.Wait()
    return results
}

// cleanup needs the lock
func (c *Cache) cleanup() {
    c.mu.Lock()
    defer c.mu.Unlock()
    // ... iteration safe now
}
```
